description: 意大利慢棋 C50 — 白方及时易位，Bg5施压，Bxf6制造叠兵+g线开放

intro.popup_en: Castling, Lesson 5: White castles on move six, while Black delays with ...Qd7. White uses the hesitation to pin Nf6 with Bg5, then exchanges with Bxf6 to create doubled pawns and open the g-file. This is the cost of delaying castling.
intro.popup:
王车易位第5课
白方第6步就易位，黑方却走Qd7拖延！
观察白方Bg5如何抓住黑方的犹豫，
最终Bxf6造成叠兵和g线开放——
这就是推迟易位的代价。

outro.popup_en: Delaying castling lets Bg5 pin Nf6 and force the knight to retreat to e7. Bxf6 then creates doubled f-pawns and opens the g-file; after Qd2 and a rook move to d1, White keeps a stable initiative. The lesson: ...Qd7 is questionable because Black could have castled and secured the king.
outro.popup:
推迟易位的后果：
① Bg5钉住Nf6，黑方被迫Ne7退步
② Bxf6强制叠兵，g线永久开放
③ Qd2后续Rfd1，白方有稳定的主动权

教训：Qd7是疑问手，本来可以保护马的！

moves.popup_en: 1.e4 occupies the center in an open game.
moves.popup: ⬆️ 1.e4 — 开放局，占据中心。

moves.popup_en: 1...e5 mirrors the central occupation and begins the Italian Game structure.
moves.popup: ⬇️ 1...e5 — 对称占中心，意大利体系起点。

moves.popup_en: 2.Nf3 develops and attacks e5.
moves.popup: ⬆️ 2.Nf3 — 白马出动，攻击 e5。

moves.popup_en: 2...Nc6 develops and protects e5.
3.Bc4 develops the Italian bishop and targets f7.
moves.popup: ⬆️ 3.Bc4 — 意大利象，瞄准 f7。

moves.popup_en: 3...Bc5 mirrors White's development and targets f2.
moves.popup: ⬇️ 3...Bc5 — 黑象对称发展，瞄准 f2。

moves.popup_en: 4.d3! The Pianissimo setup supports e4 instead of rushing d4. White will complete development and castle before advancing in the center.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.d3 — 慢棋体系！巩固 e4，不急推 d4。
白方选择稳健的 Pianissimo 路线，先完成子力发展和易位，再考虑中心推进。

moves.popup_en: 4...Nf6 develops and controls e4.
moves.popup: ⬇️ 4...Nf6 — 黑马出动，控制 e4。

moves.popup_en: 5.Nc3 develops White's second knight and supports the center.
moves.popup: ⬆️ 5.Nc3 — 白方第二马出动，支援中心。

moves.popup_en: 5...d6 reinforces e5 and opens the diagonal for Black's bishop on c8.
moves.popup: ⬇️ 5...d6 — 黑方巩固 e5，开放 c8 象。

moves.popup_en: 6.O-O! White castles as soon as the minor pieces are developed. The king reaches g1 and the rook becomes active on f1, ready for Bg5 or d4. This is model play: finish development, then castle without delay.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 6.O-O — 白方及时易位！王安全！
轻子全部出动，立刻易位。王到 g1，f1 车激活，为下一步 Bg5 或 d4 做好准备。
🔑 这是白方的模范操作：发展完成→立刻易位，不拖延！

moves.popup_en: 6...Qd7?! Black moves the queen instead of castling. The king remains on e8 and the bishop on f8 has not moved, so the kingside is not ready. The purpose of Qd7 is unclear, and the delay gives White time to exploit the uncastled king.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...Qd7 — 黑方走后而非易位！
Qd7 看似准备连接车，但此刻黑王仍在 e8，f8 象还在原位，王翼没有清理好。
⚠️ 关键疑问：黑方为什么不 O-O？Qd7目的不明确， 黑方将推迟易位——这给了白方抓住机会的时间！

moves.popup_en: 7.Bg5! White immediately takes advantage and pins Nf6. White has castled while Black's king remains in the center, making each attacking tempo especially powerful.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.Bg5 — 白方立刻抓住机会！钉住 Nf6！
Bg5 钉住 f6 马。
🎯 白方已经易位，黑方还没有。这正是 Bg5 施压的最好时机：对手王还在中央，每一步攻击都有分量！

moves.popup_en: 7...Ne7 retreats the pinned knight and avoids an exchange on f6, but gives up central control and still leaves Black uncastled. The retreat costs time and lets White build the initiative.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...Ne7 — 黑马被迫退步！
Nf6 在钉制下无法轻易移动，黑方选择 Ne7 撤退——让出 f6 格，避免被换掉。但马退到 e7，对中心的控制减弱，且仍未易位。
⚠️ 退步 = 浪费时间。每步退步都让白方多积累一步主动权。

moves.popup_en: 8.d4! White opens the center while the king is safe and the pieces are coordinated. Black must respond with the king still on e8 and the e5-pawn under pressure.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.d4 — 中心推进！乘势扩大优势。
白方子力协调，王已安全，立刻推 d4 打开局面。e5 兵面临压力，黑方必须回应，而此时黑王仍在 e8！

moves.popup_en: 8...exd4 opens the e-file. Black's king is still on e8, so pressure along the file may become dangerous.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...exd4 — 黑方兑换，打开 e 线。
黑方吃掉 d4，e 线半开放，而黑王仍在 e8——e 线压力随时可能到来。

moves.popup_en: 9.Nxd4! White recaptures and reinforces central control, while keeping threats against Nc6 and coordinating with Bg5.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 9.Nxd4 — 马重夺 d4，巩固中心。
白马到 d4，控制中心，同时威胁 Nc6 或配合 Bg5 发动进攻。白方阵型整体协调。

moves.popup_en: 9...O-O finally secures Black's king, but the delay has already cost time. Bg5 forced the knight away from f6, and White can now use Bxf6 to damage the pawn structure. White castled three moves earlier and used those tempi to build pressure.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 9...O-O — 黑方终于易位！但已经被动。
黑方迟迟才完成易位——但代价已经到来：Bg5 的钉制使 Nf6 被迫退走，而接下来白方将用 Bxf6 强制叠兵！
💡 对比白方第6步的及时易位，黑方晚了整整3步。这3步的差距，白方全部用来积累压力。

moves.popup_en: 10.Bxf6! White exchanges on f6 and forces ...gxf6. The strategic goals are to create doubled f-pawns on f7 and f6 and open the g-file beside Black's king on g8.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 10.Bxf6 — 白方主动兑换！制造叠兵！
白象吃掉 f6 格上的……实际上是 Ne7 之后 f6 仍是黑方的兵/格。白方主动兑换，强制黑方 gxf6 重提。
🎯 这步棋的战略意图：① 制造黑方叠兵（f7+f6）；② 打开 g 线——黑王就在 g8！

moves.popup_en: 10...gxf6 leaves Black with doubled f-pawns and opens the g-file. The f-pawns are difficult to advance, and the king on g8 may face rook pressure along the open file; Black's kingside structure is permanently weakened.
moves.popup:
⬇️ 10...gxf6 — 叠兵！g 线开放！
黑方只能用 g 兵吃回，f7+f6 叠兵形成，g 线完全开放。
📊 黑方的长期弱点：
• f6、f7 叠兵难以推进，后翼无用
• g 线开放，黑王在 g8 直接暴露在白方车的潜在攻击下
• 黑方王翼兵形结构永久性损坏

moves.popup_en: 11.Qd2! White develops the queen and coordinates pressure toward the g-file with a possible Rg1. The sequence shows the cost of delaying castling: ...Qd7 allowed Bg5 to pin Nf6, ...Ne7 to lose time, and Bxf6 to damage Black's pawns and open the g-file. White gained a lasting initiative from the timing advantage.
moves.popup:
⬆️ 11.Qd2 — 后发展，瞄准 g 线！
Qd2 连通后翼，后视线对准 g5 方向，与 f1 车的潜在 Rg1 形成对 g 线的立体控制。
🏁 第5局总结——推迟易位的代价：
• 黑方 Qd7 拖延易位 → Bg5 钉马 → Ne7 退步（浪费时间）
• 迟到的 O-O → Bxf6 强制叠兵 → g 线开放，王翼永久残破
白方仅用易位时机的优势，就将黑方的兵形搞残、g 线送给自己——这就是「及时易位 vs 推迟易位」最直观的差距！
